bookings.notes: Heathrow Terminal 5. World Traveller (economy) both ways — no upgrade (yet). SEATS CONFIRMED. Outbound BA220: Michael 20D, Louise 20E, Meghan 20F — row 20 is the bulkhead (extra legroom), all three together; Kenna one row back at 21K (window). Return BA221: Meghan 20F (bulkhead, extra legroom), Michael 21J, Kenna 21H, Louise 21K (row 21 together). Both Meghan & Michael have Dr. Senol letters (aisle/extra legroom, early boarding, refrigerated meds + syringes in cabin). BA declined an emailed copy — bring the printed letters to the desk. Online check-in is erroring; check in at the STL counter and ask the agent about a World Traveller Plus upgrade or holding the row 20 bulkhead. Sunflower lanyards worn from STL. (Note: BA seat page shows 21:40 departure / 8h00 — arrival computed ~11:40; verify in the BA app.)

events.text: ⏰ Online check-in is erroring — check in at the STL counter tonight. Seats are CONFIRMED (you're in the row 20 bulkhead — don't let the desk move you out of it). Bring Dr. Senol's printed letters and ask about a World Traveller Plus upgrade. TSA PreCheck is covered by Global Entry, so don't sweat what prints.
BA220 · STL → LHR · World Traveller
Overnight flight — arrives June 8 at ~11:40 AM (Terminal 5)

items.text: Final packing check: passports for all 4 (including Louise, age 5)
Charge all devices, download offline entertainment for overnight flight
Pack carry-on essentials: snacks, change of clothes, toothbrush — you land midday and go straight to the hotel
Light dinner before heading to airport. UberX picks up 7:20 PM → at STL ~7:36 PM, ~4 hrs before the 21:40 departure (you'll want the time — check-in is at the counter)
Kids' iPads loaded + headphones packed for 8-hr overnight flight
Wear the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower lanyards (all 4) from STL. Recognized at Heathrow, St Pancras/Gare du Nord, and Disneyland Paris — discreet, patient assistance at every checkpoint.

Refrigerated meds + syringes stay in carry-on (Meghan: Benlysta + GLP-1; Michael: Repatha). Keep Dr. Senol's letters printed AND on your phone. Declare medically-necessary liquids/gel packs at security — allowed over 100ml.
Michael's rescue inhaler within reach for the flight — not buried in the overhead bag.
Early/pre-boarding: ask at the gate — it's logged on the booking via the BA Accessibility call. Helps you get settled and stow the medical cooler.

Seats CONFIRMED — outbound you're in the row 20 bulkhead: Michael 20D, Louise 20E, Meghan 20F (extra legroom), Kenna one row back at 21K. Don't let online tools or the desk move you out of row 20. Return: Meghan 20F bulkhead, the other three together in row 21.
BA220 · STL → LHR · Departs 21:40, arrives ~11:40+1 · Terminal 5
World Traveller (economy). Booking ref: YUAD5K
Paid with 260,000 Avios + $1,083.86 in taxes/fees
Flight is ~8 hours. Meal service included. Try to sleep — you land midday and need to power through Day 1
✅ UK ETA approved for all 4 — have the confirmation emails on your phones at the gate.
✅ BA Advance Passenger Info complete for all 4 (passport + KTN on file).
Overnight flight with a 5-year-old: bring comfort items, tablet loaded with shows, noise-canceling if possible

items.text: Have UK ETA confirmation accessible on phone for each passenger
Brush teeth, wash face before landing — you'll want to feel somewhat fresh
Have hotel address ready: Travelodge London Kings Cross Royal Scot
Immigration at T5 — can take 30-60 min. E-gates may work for US adults with ETA; kids under 12 use staffed desks
Heathrow Express: Pre-booked (ref 69d52862). Platform in T5 basement level. 15 min to Paddington
Paddington → Kings Cross: Hammersmith & City or Circle line → Kings Cross St Pancras (~20 min). Use contactless payment
Travelodge: Early check-in available from noon! Walk from Kings Cross station ~5 min
Jet lag will hit HARD, especially Louise. Power through until 7-8 PM local time to reset body clocks
Don't over-plan Day 1. Coal Drops Yard is a 5-min walk — perfect low-key exploring
Contactless payment works everywhere in London (Tube, buses, shops). No cash needed
Louise might crash mid-afternoon. Have a stroller or be ready for a hotel nap break
Travelodge WiFi code: TVLRTFRPK. Breakfast included all 5 mornings
Coal Drops Yard has great kid-friendly restaurants (Pizza Pilgrims, Barrafina)
St Pancras station next door has beautiful architecture — worth a peek even on arrival day
Kenna Oyster card: Buy at Paddington or Kings Cross Tube station (£7). Ask staff to add Young Visitor discount (50% off, 14 days). Kenna must be present. Louise rides free everywhere as under-11
Adults + transport: Apple Pay on your iPhones works on all London transport (Tube, buses, Thames Clipper). Just tap at the yellow readers. Auto-caps at daily rate. No Oyster card needed for adults

items.text: First breakfast at Travelodge — check time/location at front desk
Save London Eye e-ticket on phone (Order #601617735). Screenshot as backup
Check weather — this is a heavily outdoor day (Westminster, parks, river)
Pack layers, rain jackets, comfy walking shoes — BIG walking day

Thames Clipper: Buy tickets at pier (Oyster/contactless works). Runs every 20 min
All walking between Westminster, St James's Park, Buckingham Palace, and South Bank is doable (~25 min stretches)
London Eye at 1:00 PM is a FIXED time. Work backwards from this — don't linger at Buckingham Palace
Changing of the Guard only happens certain days — check online. Huge crowds if it's on
South Bank can be overwhelming with 2 kids. Pick a focused stretch near London Eye rather than walking end to end
St James's Park playground is excellent for Louise — perfect mid-morning energy burn
Southbank Centre Food Market (Fri-Sun) has great diverse food at reasonable prices
Thames Clipper is both transport AND sightseeing — great for tired legs after the Eye

items.text: Download Matilda e-tickets to phone. Ref: 26042Q-6YAMRCW8CJ
Cambridge Theatre, Seven Dials (Covent Garden area). Dress Circle Row A, Seats 23-26
Book V&A Fashion Tour if not done yet (vam.ac.uk, 12:30 PM slot)
Plan the tight transfer: V&A → Matilda has only a 25 min buffer
Kings Cross → Covent Garden: Piccadilly line, ~10 min
Covent Garden → V&A (South Kensington): Piccadilly line, ~10 min
V&A → Cambridge Theatre: Tube South Ken → Leicester Square (Piccadilly, ~12 min) + 5 min walk
⏱ TIGHT TRANSFER: V&A tour ends ~1:15 PM. Matilda curtain is 2:00 PM sharp. Only ~45 min door-to-door with Tube. If tour runs over, you're sprinting
Contingency: If running late, skip Tube and taxi V&A → Cambridge Theatre (~15 min, ~£12)
Alternative: Drop V&A tour entirely. Museum is free to explore casually instead — zero stress
Matilda is 2 hrs 40 min. Louise (age 5) needs to sit through the whole show — bring a quiet snack
Covent Garden street performers are free and kids love them — perfect morning entertainment
Dress Circle Row A is phenomenal — front of the upper level with full unobstructed stage view
Post-show: you're in Seven Dials/Covent Garden. Chinatown is a 5-min walk for dinner

Regent's Park playgrounds / pedal boats

items.text: Flex day — no fixed bookings! Sleep in if jet lag is still lingering
British Museum is free, no timed entry needed. Opens 10 AM
Kings Cross → British Museum: 20 min walk through Bloomsbury, or Tube 1 stop to Russell Square
British Museum → Regent's Park: 15 min walk north
British Museum is ENORMOUS. Don't try to see everything. Pick 2-3 highlights: Egyptian mummies, Rosetta Stone, Greek marbles
Museum fatigue is real with kids. 2 hours max, then get outside to Regent's Park
Regent's Park has fantastic playgrounds and pedal boats on the boating lake
This is your buffer/recovery day. If something from earlier was missed, today is the makeup day
Close to hotel — easy to pop back for an afternoon rest if Louise needs it

events.text: 👨‍👧 Michael + Louise: Natural History Museum
👩‍👧 Meghan + Kenna: Tate Modern + Millennium Bridge
Regroup for lunch or afternoon

items.text: Confirm Natural History Museum timed entry (nhm.ac.uk)

Print/save Eurostar tickets. Ref: QRXPZK. Check-in opens 45 min before departure
Lay out tomorrow's clothes. Bags by the door. Everyone in bed by 9 PM

CRITICAL: Pack for Paris tonight. You will NOT have time tomorrow morning — Eurostar departs 6:31 AM

items.text: Bags packed by door. Alarm 5:15 AM. Clothes laid out
Eurostar tickets on phone. Ref: QRXPZK. Train 9002, Coach 10, Seats 18/17/13/14
Travelodge is 5-min walk to St Pancras — leave hotel by 5:30 AM latest
No hotel breakfast (too early). Grab pastries at St Pancras or eat on Eurostar
Leg 1: Walk to St Pancras (5 min). Check-in opens 5:46 AM. Gates close 6:01 AM. Be there 5:45
Leg 2: Eurostar 9002 · 06:31→09:57 Paris Gare du Nord. Security + UK exit + French entry checks before boarding
Leg 3: Gare du Nord → Trocadéro: Metro Line 4 → Line 6 (or Line 9). ~30 min
Leg 4: Eiffel Tower area → Disney: Metro to Châtelet, RER A to Marne-la-Vallée/Chessy. ~1 hour. ~€5/person
Dream Castle shuttle: Free from Disney bus station. Runs ~every 20 min
5:15 AM alarm with a 5-year-old. Have Louise's clothes and a snack ready to go
✅ Eiffel Tower tickets BOOKED! 4 tickets, Summit by Elevator, 11:00 AM entry. €101.00 (~$121). E-tickets sent via email — print or have on phone.
Arrive at Trocadéro by ~10:15 for photos, then walk to tower entrance for 11:00 entry. Allow 20-30 min in the security + elevator queue even with timed tickets.
RER A to Disney: Validate your tickets! Fine for no validation is €50+
Watch belongings on Paris metro — tourist areas are pickpocket-heavy
Eurostar has a bar car — coffee and pastries once onboard
Dream Castle pool has a water slide! Let the kids burn energy after travel
Disney Village is walkable — good for dinner without park tickets
Eiffel Tower: BOOKED — 11:00 AM summit entry. Have e-tickets ready on phone. Trocadéro photos first, then walk across to the tower.

events.text: Check out Dream Castle. Shuttle/walk to Art of Marvel.
Early check-in at Art of Marvel — get MagicPass + Priority Card at concierge desk (room not ready until 3 PM)
Head to Disney Adventure World entrance (10-min walk)
⭐ EXTRA MAGIC TIME — early access! (Art of Marvel arrival day = eligible)
All 4 together: Crush's Coaster (Louise clears 107cm!), Spider-Man W.E.B., then split for Avengers Assemble
📱 OPEN APP AT 08:30: Join Anna & Elsa Royal Encounter Virtual Queue — FREE but fills in minutes. Must be physically inside the park. Louise will want this. Do it before your first ride.
Park opens to public. Crowds arrive — switch to lower-wait rides

Ratatouille (2D refurb!), Tower of Terror, Raiponce Tangled Spin — use Priority Card at MagicALL entrances throughout the day. Save Frozen Ever After for late evening (22 min wait at 10pm vs 93 min at 9am).
🍽️ Lunch: Bistrot Chez Rémy — meal voucher 1
Continue rides. Use SNACK+DRINK voucher mid-afternoon (Pause Gourmande)
Room ready — drop bags at Art of Marvel
🍽️ Dinner: PYM Kitchen — meal voucher 2
Evening rides — Frozen Ever After wait drops dramatically: ~60 min at 7pm → 47 min at 8pm → 22 min at 10pm. This is the prime Frozen window. Single Rider also available for faster boarding.

Head to Adventure Bay lakefront for Cascade of Lights. Priority Card: show card at dedicated accessible viewing area for best unobstructed view. General: arrive 30-40 min early for a good standing spot at the fjord railing.
✨ Disney Cascade of Lights — nightly closing spectacular: fireworks, water-screen projections, drones + aquatic drones (new May 2026 enhancement). Priority Card = dedicated lakefront viewing area.
Disney Adventure World closes at 22:40. Walk back to Art of Marvel.
🍸 Skyline Bar at Art of Marvel — use DRINK VOUCHER (cocktails/mocktails!)
🎟️ All meals + drinks today covered by Full-board Extra Plus (4 vouchers used)

items.text: Set alarm 6:30 AM. Pack day bag: chargers, sunscreen, snacks, rain layer
Download Disneyland Paris app. Link booking #32984124 to Disney Account
Ensure MagicPass and meal vouchers are accessible in app (mobile check-in opens Jun 7)
Charge phones to 100% — app-heavy day (wait times, dining, Premier Access)
Bring a portable battery pack!
Dream Castle → Art of Marvel: ~10-15 min shuttle or walk through Disney Village
Art of Marvel → Disney Adventure World entrance: ~10 min walk. Security opens ~30 min before EMT

Pick up MagicPass + Priority Card (ref PMR-Y1O-KGA-273-FRD) at Art of Marvel concierge desk. Bring original disability document for Priority Card. Valid for 6 days — covers both park days. No separate pickup needed June 15.

At check-in: Request same room for both nights. Tell front desk you have booking #32984124 (Jun 14) and #H-DKH4WQD368V2 (Jun 15) — ask them to assign the same room. This is the most reliable way to get it done
Dream Castle checkout: Don't wait until 11 AM! Check out ~7:00 to maximize EMT
Art of Marvel early check-in gets your MagicPass, but room isn't ready until 3 PM. Leave bags at hotel luggage storage
Louise (est. 115cm in June) CLEARS Crush's Coaster (107cm), Big Thunder Mountain (102cm), and Tower of Terror (102cm)!
Louise CANNOT ride: Avengers Assemble: Flight Force (120cm), Hyperspace Mountain (120cm), Indiana Jones (140cm) — use Parent Swap for these 3
Bistrot Chez Rémy at 11:45 AM is FIXED. Set phone alarm — easy to lose track on rides
PYM Kitchen at 6:00 PM — same. Don't queue for a ride at 5:30 thinking you'll make it
⚠️ CLOSED June 14: Cars Road Trip (June 8-19), Slinky Dog ZigZag Spin (June 1-26). Both were in the original plan. Use RC Racer and Toy Soldiers Parachute Drop instead in Toy Story Playland.

Anna & Elsa Royal Encounter: FREE virtual queue, but it fills in minutes. The moment you enter the park at 08:30 during EMT, have the DLP app open and join the VQ before touching a single ride. This is Louise's can't-miss moment. If you miss the morning release, watch for an afternoon drop.

EMT Strategy (8:30–9:30): Enter at 08:30. FIRST: open the DLP app and join the Anna & Elsa Royal Encounter virtual queue (fills in minutes!). Then: ALL FOUR → Crush's Coaster. Then Spider-Man W.E.B. Then split: Michael+Kenna → Avengers Assemble (120cm, Parent Swap for Meghan) while Meghan+Louise → Raiponce Tangled Spin or Ratatouille. Do NOT chase Frozen Ever After at EMT — 9am wait avg is 93 min. Ride it after 9pm instead (22 min avg).

Post-9:30: Tower of Terror (Louise clears 102cm! — covered queue makes wait bearable), Ratatouille (refurbished 2026 — now 2D, new Parisian artist studio queue scene), RC Racer (replaces closed Cars Road Trip), Raiponce Tangled Spin

World of Frozen strategy: Frozen Ever After (boat ride) — best at 9-10pm (22 min avg wait vs 93 min at 9am). Use Priority Card during the day for a manageable wait anytime. Single Rider available. Royal Encounter (Anna & Elsa meet): FREE virtual queue required — join via DLP app at 08:30 inside the park, one slot per group, fills in minutes. Second release in the afternoon — check app if you miss morning. A Celebration in Arendelle outdoor show: stand at the Arendelle Bay fjord railing, arrive 15-20 min early (no seating). Free-roaming robotic Olaf animatronic wanders the area — legitimately impressive.

NEW Adventure Way (opened Mar 29): Raiponce Tangled Spin (spinner ride under glowing lanterns — Louise's new favorite!), themed gardens (Toy Story, Tangled, British), Regal View Restaurant & Lounge (Princess character dining — first in-park bar at DLP!), new Mickey & Minnie meet and greet

Disney Cascade of Lights (22:40 — park closing show): Fireworks, water-screen projections, drones, and aquatic drones on Adventure Bay. Get to the lakefront by 22:00 for a good general standing spot. Priority Card holders: show card at the dedicated accessible viewing area — Cast Members seat you with the best view (up to 2 companions). This is the DAW equivalent of Illuminations — don't miss it. Park closes immediately after at 22:40.
Avengers Assemble: Flight Force (120cm): Louise can't ride. Parent Swap — one adult rides with Kenna, then swaps. Free!
Standby Pass (FREE!): Reserve free return-time slots in the app. Only hold 1 at a time. Combine with Premier Access for max efficiency
Single Rider: Available on Crush's Coaster, Ratatouille, Frozen Ever After, RC Racer. Frozen Single Rider is especially effective — significantly faster than standby during peak hours.
Louise highlights: Frozen Ever After (boat ride!), Raiponce Tangled Spin (lanterns!), Ratatouille, Cars Road Trip, A Celebration in Arendelle show, Anna & Elsa meet and greet

A Million Splashes of Colour (Adventure Way, multiple daily): Outdoor character show on Adventure Way. Good for filling gaps between meals — check app for exact times. Also: Disney Marching Band (12 musicians) roams Adventure Way throughout the day.

Priority Card — how it works: Walk up to any ride's MagicALL/accessible entrance, show the card, Cast Member directs you to the Premier Pass lane. Typical wait: 10-25 min instead of 60-90+ min standby. No return times, no app booking. Valid for Meghan + all 4 of you. Use it all day on every headliner.
Skip Premier Access Ultimate — Priority Card replaces 4-6 PA One passes per day for free. Between the Priority Card and late-evening Frozen (22 min wait), you don't need it.
Buy 1-2 Premier Access One strategically (~€8-18/ride, purchased in-app once inside park):

#1: Frozen Ever After — use Priority Card, not PA One. Walk up to MagicALL entrance anytime. Or ride after 9pm (22 min avg wait) — no card needed at that point, just use standby. Save your PA One euros.
#2: If you need PA One at all — use it for a second Frozen ride if you want a re-ride mid-afternoon (before the evening drop). That's it. Total PA One budget: ~€0-30.
Skip PA for: Cars Road Trip (short waits), Tower of Terror (preshow means PA still takes 15-20 min)
Parent Swap (free!): Only needed for Avengers Assemble: Flight Force (120cm). One adult rides with Kenna, then the other swaps — no re-queuing
Revised budget with Priority Card: ~€0-30 total (vs original €96 estimate). Priority Card covers every major headliner. Only spend PA One if you want a specific second ride mid-peak.
No breakfast voucher today — you slept at Dream Castle (not covered by meal plan)
11:45 AM — Bistrot Chez Rémy → MEAL VOUCHER 1. Table service = starter + main + dessert + soft drink (kids). Order all 3 courses — they're included, don't skip any!
~3:00 PM — Pause Gourmande → SNACK + DRINK VOUCHER. Pastry + hot/cold drink at any quick-service. Perfect mid-ride fuel. Don't waste this at breakfast!
6:00 PM — PYM Kitchen → MEAL VOUCHER 2. All-you-can-eat buffet + soft drink. Go back for seconds — best calorie-per-voucher value

~9:00 PM — Skyline Bar (Art of Marvel) → DRINK VOUCHER. 1 alcoholic OR non-alcoholic drink per person. Cocktails run €12-16 — high-value use! Michael & Meghan: cocktails. Kenna & Louise: mocktails/milkshakes
Excluded restaurants: Starbucks, McDonald's, Rainforest Café, Five Guys, Earl of Sandwich, Vapiano, The Royal Pub, Brasserie Rosalie — vouchers NOT accepted
$0 out of pocket for all food + drinks today

events.text: 🍽️ Breakfast at Art of Marvel — BREAKFAST VOUCHER (only included breakfast of trip)
Head to Disneyland Park entrance (10-min walk)
⭐ EXTRA MAGIC TIME — early access! (Art of Marvel guest)
All 4 → Big Thunder Mountain. Then split: Hyperspace Mtn (Parent Swap) + Peter Pan (walk-on!)
Park opens to public. Crowds arrive — switch to lower-wait rides
🍽️ Lunch: Royal Banquet — LAST DAY VOUCHER + character dining 👸
Afternoon: Snow White's Scary Adventures (just reopened June 13!), Phantom Manor, Peter Pan's Flight (Priority Card!), Le Pays des Contes de Fées
Disney Stars on Parade — modified route this year (sharp right via Discoveryland due to castle bridge work). Position on Discoveryland side of Main Street. Check app for exact time (~14:40 est).

🦁 The Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands (Frontierland) — one of DLP's best shows. Also at 12:30, 13:30, 17:05. AND: 🎭 Mickey and the Magician is FINAL DAY today (June 15) — check app for times if kids want it.

⏰ Return check-in (BA221). Seats are confirmed: Meghan 20F (bulkhead), Michael 21J, Kenna 21H, Louise 21K. If online check-in errors like the outbound, just check in at the LHR T5 counter tomorrow. Don't reshuffle.
🍽️ Dinner: Quick-service (NO voucher left — ~€40-60 out of pocket)
Stay in Art of Marvel (same room)
✨ Disney Tales of Magic — castle projections + fireworks + drones at Sleeping Beauty Castle (park closing spectacular). Priority Card = dedicated accessible viewing area front-left of castle.
Disneyland Park closes (~22:40-22:50). Walk back to hotel.
⚠ Pack tonight — 7:30 AM checkout tomorrow!

items.text: Set alarm 6:15 AM. Breakfast opens early — be there by 7:00 to eat and still make EMT
Check parade and show times in app tonight. Plan around Disney Stars on Parade + Illuminations
Charge phones again. Another full app-heavy day
Royal Banquet at 12:30 is at the DISNEYLAND HOTEL (not your hotel). Know the walking route — allow 15 min

Return seats confirmed: Meghan 20F (bulkhead, extra legroom), Michael 21J, Kenna 21H, Louise 21K (row 21 together). If online check-in errors like the outbound, check in at the LHR T5 desk and present Dr. Senol's letters to ask about a World Traveller Plus upgrade. Don't reshuffle out of these seats.
Sunflower lanyards on for the Gare du Nord → St Pancras → Heathrow → STL journey. Keep Dr. Senol's letters and the medical cooler accessible.
Refrigerated meds: repack the cooler with fresh frozen gel packs (hotel ice works) the morning of departure for the long travel day home.
Michael's inhaler within reach; early boarding available at LHR T5 — ask at the gate.
Art of Marvel → Disneyland Park entrance: ~10 min walk through Disney Village
Security checkpoint opens ~30 min before EMT (~7:30 AM)
Royal Banquet: Inside the Disneyland Hotel (castle building above park entrance). Exit park → walk through hotel lobby → restaurant. Allow 15 min each way

⚠️ CLOSED June 15: Pirates of the Caribbean (June 15-30), Alice's Curious Labyrinth (all June through July 3), Dumbo the Flying Elephant (June 8-19). All three were in the original afternoon plan — all removed. Replaced with: Snow White's Scary Adventures, Le Pays des Contes de Fées, Carrousel de Lancelot, Lion King show.
Royal Banquet at 12:30 is OUTSIDE the park (in Disneyland Hotel). Exit and re-enter. Allow 15 min each way
Character dining takes ~75-90 min with princesses visiting tables. Don't rush — this is a highlight for the kids
Peter Pan's Flight: 60-90 min standby waits. Use Priority Card — walk to MagicALL accessible entrance, show card, ~10-25 min. Do not queue standby for this. Covered.

Disney Tales of Magic at ~22:40 — Louise will be exhausted after 14+ hours. Consider having one parent take her back to the hotel after dinner (~20:00) while the other stays with Kenna for the fireworks. Or: stroller + Priority Card accessible viewing area. Don't push it if she's melting down.
⚠️ PACK TONIGHT! 7:30 AM checkout tomorrow. You will NOT have time in the morning

Disney Stars on Parade takes a modified route this year (sharp right at Discoveryland, not through Fantasyland) due to Sleeping Beauty Castle bridge refurbishment. Check app for time and updated route map. Don't stake out a spot on the wrong side of the park.

EMT Strategy (8:30–9:30): ALL FOUR → Big Thunder Mountain first (Louise clears 102cm!). Then split: Meghan+Louise → Peter Pan's Flight (use Priority Card at accessible entrance — 10-25 min vs 60-90 standby) while Michael+Kenna → Hyperspace Mountain (120cm). Meet up at 9:30 for public opening.
Post-9:30: Snow White's Scary Adventures (just reopened June 13 — Louise's movie!), Phantom Manor, Buzz Lightyear (all family-friendly, all 4 together). Use Priority Card throughout.

After Royal Banquet (~14:00): Le Pays des Contes de Fées (fairy-tale boat ride through storybook scenes — no height req, virtually no wait, Louise will love it), Carrousel de Lancelot (open, no queue), Mad Hatter's Tea Cups, Snow White if not done yet. ⚠️ Pirates, Alice's Labyrinth, and Dumbo are all CLOSED — do not plan these.
Parent Swap rides (120cm+): Hyperspace Mountain only. Indiana Jones (140cm) — Kenna only, both adults swap. That's it — Louise rides almost everything else!

Parade Strategy (~14:40): Disney Stars on Parade runs a modified route this year — takes a sharp right via Discoveryland entrance (Sleeping Beauty Castle bridge under refurbishment). Large Princess float replaced by carriages temporarily. Best viewing: Discoveryland side of Main Street, or in Discoveryland itself. OR skip the parade and ride headliners during the 45-min window when queues drop 30-50%.
Evening (7-10 PM): Re-ride favorites. Queues drop significantly after dinner. Fantasyland rides nearly walk-on after 8 PM

~22:40 — Disney Tales of Magic: Castle projections + fireworks + drones at Sleeping Beauty Castle (this is the park's closing spectacular — not "Illuminations," that was the old show). Claim a spot in Central Plaza 20-30 min early. Priority Card: dedicated accessible viewing area front-left of castle — show card to Cast Member. Castle bridge scaffolding affects some angles but the show compensates with extra fireworks.
Single Rider: Big Thunder Mountain and Ratatouille both have it. Great for a quick re-ride

🦁 Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands (starts June 13): Theater of the Stars, Frontierland. Runs at 12:30, 13:30, 16:05, 17:05. One of the best shows at DLP — high production, live performers, Elton John soundtrack. The 16:05 show fits perfectly after the Royal Banquet. Don't skip this.

🎭 Mickey and the Magician — FINAL DAY (June 15): This fan-favorite Disney Adventure World show ends its run today. If you haven't seen it, check the app for showtimes and work it in. After June 15 it's gone until its next run.

Crowd intel: June 15 (Monday) is one of the lightest crowd days of the entire month — noticeably better than June 14 (Sunday). Combined with Priority Card access, this is about as manageable as DLP gets in summer. Headliner waits will be shorter than Day 1 across the board.
Best PA One targets for Disneyland Park today:
#1: Peter Pan's Flight — use Priority Card, not PA One. Walk to accessible MagicALL entrance, show card, ~10-25 min wait vs 60-90 min standby. Free. Repeat if you want a second ride.
#2: If you spend any PA One at all — save it for a specific re-ride you really want. Total budget today: ~€0-20. Priority Card handles Peter Pan, and crowd levels on Monday are lighter anyway.
Skip PA for: Phantom Manor (rarely 25+ min), Pirates (walk-on after 5 PM), Buzz (moderate waits)
Parent Swap only needed for 2 rides today: Hyperspace Mountain (120cm) and Indiana Jones (140cm, Kenna only). That's it!
